name: Handwritten Digit Classifier
description: Build and train a small CNN from randomly initialized weights to classify handwritten digits from 0 to 9. Train on MNIST and evaluate accuracy, loss curves and checkpoint saving.

name: An Brain Tumor Detection
description: A brain tumor detection model is an automated system using machine learning or deep learning to analyze magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans, identify the presence of a tumor, and classify its type.
